text.text: Released in 2005, Beena was an educational console developed by Sega Toys for young children in Japan. Designed as a successor to Sega's Advanced Pico Beena, it combined learning activities, games, and interactive content with a controller designed for younger users. The system supported cartridge-based software covering subjects such as reading, mathematics, drawing, and character-based games. Beena continued Sega's educational hardware line by focusing on interactive learning through games.
